title: FlexTrap
description: Traps and walls for your server. Supports MiniMessage and full configuration!
body:
> 🧨 A powerful and flexible plugin for creating traps and walls (like fortnite) in Minecraft that turns ordinary gameplay into a real mind game. Create hidden, deadly, or clever traps and control every detail of their behavior.


## ⚙️ Options

- 🧠 Flexible trap and walls system — adjust the radius, effects, and activation conditions
- 💥 Different types of traps — potions, action bar, boss bar, messages
- 👁️ Invisible traps — perfect for anarchy and PvP
- 🧩 Plugin support MINIMessage, WorldGuard
- 🙂 Support Oraxen, ItemsAdder with Model Data
- ⚡ Instant response without lag
- 🔧 Full configuration via config
- 🛡️ Protection against bugs and abuse


## 🔥 Perfect for:

1. **Anarchy**
2. PvP / PvE servers
3. Mini-Games
4. Hardcore
5. Events for players


## ### 
##  🚀 Technical Info
- 🧱 Version Minecraft: 1.21.8
- ☕ Java: JDK 21
- ⚙️ Platrforms: Paper / Spigot
- 📦 Lightweight and optimized code

### **Dependencies:**
- **WorldEdit 7.4.0**
- **WorldGuard 7.0.14**
- **PlaceholderAPI**


## Commands
- **/trap** >>> view all available commands
- **/trap give** <name-trap> [player] <amount>  >>> give a trap
- **/trap giveplast** <name-plast> [player] <amount>  >>> give a wall
- **/trap reload** >>> reload config
- **/trap list** >>> view all traps
- **/trap check** >>> check schematics


<details>
<summary>Permissions</summary>

## Permissions:
- >   trapka.admin:
- >     description: Allow access to all commands
- >     default: op
- >   trapka.give:
- >     description: Authorize the issuance of walls and traps
- >     default: op
- >   trapka.reload:
- >     description: Allow plugin to restart
- >     default: op
- >   trapka.use:
- >     description: Allow the use of traps
- >     default: true
- >   trapka.use.plast:
- >     description: Allow the use of walls
- >     default: true
- >   trapka.bypass.cooldown:
- >     description: Reload bypass
- >     default: op
- >   trapka.bypass.region:
- >     description: Bypassing regions
- >     default: op

</details>



## Install:
> 1. Install the plugin **FlexTrap**
> 2. Be sure to install **[WorldEdit](https://modrinth.com/plugin/worldedit/versions)**, **[WorldGuard](https://modrinth.com/plugin/worldguard/versions)**
> 3. Move all plugins to the folder Plugins
> 4. Start the server, change everything necessary in **Config.yml** & **Messages.yml** be sure to add **schematic** in folder **WorldEdit** (if it doesn't work, add it to the folder FlexTrap with Schematics).
